_comment: Weekly update from the EOW sent each Friday. `outreach` counts vendor-campaign EMAILS sent (follow-ups included); candidate-sourcing and other non-campaign work is moved to channels_excluded and never counted; LinkedIn is tracked in `linkedin`, separate from the email total. `connected_email` is genuine human replies only — NOT HubSpot's reply field, which logs Mailsuite 'not opened yet' notifications as replies and is therefore unusable. Keyed by the Monday opening the week. A reply only counts if it came from the vendor campaign: reconnected pipeline leads reached through separate follow-up work are listed in connected_excluded and deducted from connected_email.

weeks.label: Sep 14–18
weeks.headline: The engine produced a live sales conversation — first held DC from our own outbound, and Neighbor reached client reference checks.
highlights: Discovery Call held Sep 18 — Jerry Saballus at Corrugator, sourced directly from our own outbound rather than an inbound lead. He already runs three Philippines-based VAs and wants a top-tier EA to set standards and coach them, ideally hired before Dec 1. Only blocker is budget clarity while he switches accountants; next step is the deposit to schedule a kick-off.

Neighbor reached client reference checks — the deepest that deal has gone. The first two did not land: Rene Shalita was a use-case mismatch (small specialised accounting team vs Neighbor needing direct-sales agents at scale), and Audrey Bravo no-showed. Mark has asked for better-matched references and is out of office all next week, so line up clients running scaled direct-sales teams for his return.

Follow-up sweeps (662) — the Sep 16 second-touch cost-comparison across US/UK plus healthcare re-touches, and a Sep 18 third-touch pass on the UK vendor-registration list (banks, insurers, retail, rail, utilities, universities).

Cold first-touch (308) into new verticals: AU/generic SMB (149), US/AU healthcare (66), hospitality (32 — student accommodation, hotels, holiday parks), founder-stage tech/SaaS (24), IT-support reqs and one PE fund. No vendor-manager first-touch this week; those originals went out Sep 3 and this was the follow-up layer.
List hygiene: 12 bounces, 1 opt-out suppressed; kept mining out-of-office replies for named successors (Pentec Health → Darren Leatherman).

weeks.label: Sep 7–12
weeks.headline: High volume translating into quality — Neighbor into final security requirements and two approved-vendor pathways opened.
highlights: Neighbor advanced — Mark is through the proposal and onto security/access controls for the sales pod (restricted-access facility, clean-desk policy, locked-down endpoints, NBI-cleared agents). Security requirements at this stage is a serious-evaluation signal.

Two approved-vendor pathways opened, which is the campaign's actual goal: Gold Coast Council forwarded the inquiry to their Chief Procurement Office (route in is VendorPanel for sub-$5M engagements), and United Utilities routed us to formal registration via Achilles UVDB and Find a Tender.

Follow-up sweep (1,076) — the Sep 8 second/third touch across the UK vendor-manager and Function-Head list: banks, insurers, utilities, housing associations, universities, rail, auto dealer groups, charities and fintech.
New play: a portfolio-oversight ABM into ~16 PE funds (Vista Equity, Sumeru, Level Equity, Spectrum, Mainsail), pitching the support and engineering layer their portfolio companies already run.
Reactivation wave (99) re-opened dormant inbound/MQL leads that reached OA but never connected, across UK, AU, US and CA.
Kept mining out-of-office replies for named successors (Angels of Care → Mark Frates, The WCA → Michael Curran, Parachute Health → Matt Pestritto). List hygiene: 25 bounces, 1 opt-out suppressed.
connected_detail: Gold Coast Council (AU) — inquiry forwarded to their Chief Procurement Office; registration on VendorPanel is the route in for sub-$5M engagements
United Utilities (UK) — supplier team routed us to formal registration via Achilles UVDB and Find a Tender (still qualifying)

weeks.label: Aug 31 – Sep 5
weeks.headline: Biggest outreach week yet — healthcare follow-up sweep at scale, and the vendor play opened into three new geographies.
highlights: Follow-up sweep (1,511) — second-touch pass across the late-August campaigns, heavily weighted to US healthcare (~1,340 touches across ~227 companies: home health, hospice, DME, ASC/anesthesia, infusion, fertility, behavioral health, dental DSOs), plus UK vendor-manager follow-ups (LNER, Direct Line, NFU Mutual, LV=, Ramsay, Saga, Skipton).

Vendor Inquiry opened into three new geographies: AU/NZ (local government, water utilities, universities, aged care, energy, banks/super/insurers, telco), UK (payments/fintech ops, retail/hospitality, rail — TfL, ScotRail, GWR — media, legal, housing, university admissions), and EU/NL procurement (Merck, ING, Adyen, Aegon, NN Group, ASML, ABN AMRO).

Neighbor is alive again — Mark re-engaged, apologised for the delay, and explained their data team is building a tool to model our rates against performance expectations. The hold is an internal modelling step, not lost interest.
Mined the week's out-of-office replies for named successors to re-target (Tarmac → Jen Raia, WaterNSW → Brendan Maher, The WCA → Michael Curran) — turning role changes into fresh leads.
List hygiene: 21 bounces cleared, 1 opt-out suppressed; client-domain safety screen running before every wave.
connected_detail: LNER (Richard Judge, Head of CX) — replied warmly (“refreshing”) and referred us to Great British Railways as the right future home as rail nationalisation advances; open to reconnecting in ~12 months
A2Dominion (Mark Prosser) — referred us to their People Services team, who own the preferred-supplier list

weeks.label: Aug 24–29
weeks.headline: Full-tilt Vendor Inquiry week — the campaign run at scale across UK and US persona tracks.
highlights: Vendor Inquiry was 96% of the week (1,485 emails) across two persona tracks: UK CX/contact-centre and procurement heads (CalMac, Hays Travel, Gamma, Saga, LNER, Direct Line, The AA, Quilter, Eurostar), and US VP-Ops/COO Function-Heads at net-new consumer/CPG/beauty/toys firms (BaubleBar, Brilliant Earth, JAKKS, Sun Bum, Moose Toys, Life Extension) plus healthcare payers.
Built a client-domain safety screen on Aug 27 — 119 OA client domains pulled from HubSpot and suppressed whole-domain, now run before every wave so an existing client can never be cold-emailed.
Neighbor 10-agent proposal still pending; nudged Aug 25 and moving to a live/phone push since email went quiet after Mark's PTO.
All 3 replies this week were declines. List hygiene: 16 bounces cleared, 1 opt-out suppressed.
connected_detail: 3 replies, all declines — no names carried in the EOW
